# Preface {.unnumbered}

These are the course notes for TEMBA Statistics (B A 286T) at the McCombs
School of Business for the 2026–2027 academic year. Slides, the syllabus, and
everything else for the course live on the
[course website](https://jaredsmurray.github.io/temba_stats/); announcements
and assignments are in Canvas.

The notes will be updated as the course goes along: chapters are added as we
reach them, and existing chapters get corrections and small revisions. If a
page looks different from the last time you read it, that is why. When a change
matters for an assignment, I will say so in Canvas.
